verdict.rationale: Stripe documents restricted API keys as its least-privilege credential for agents. You set Read, Write or None per resource, all APIs support them, and Stripe explicitly recommends RAKs "especially when giving a key to an AI agent." MCP access adds OAuth sessions with per-session revoke, admin controls separated by live and sandbox, and RAK-scoped connected-account access; a live probe confirms the OAuth-gated MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that RAK permission scoping works as documented for agents, and evidence on key expiry/rotation controls for agent credentials.
